about: Texts and settings of the project website that change with the project's state, read by its updater at the latest release tag. texts.<key> fills <!--@<key>-->...<!--/@--> on the page (plain text, `code` and **bold**). notice: one line at the top of the page, "" = hidden (optional [link text] with notice_link). news: how many releases What's new shows and how many characters of each one's first paragraph. checksums: show the SHA-256 of each download under it (it is always in the link's tooltip). Checked by tools/site_figures.py --check.

texts.status: schneidi is still in early development: project files can change between versions.
texts.pi_note: There is no ARM download; the Pi build is made from source.
